documents.title: Doc 70 - Infringement - Car 5 - Red Light at Pit Exit
documents.subject: Infringement - Car 5 - Red Light at Pit Exit

details.fact: Car 5 left the pit lane when the light at the end of the pit lane was red.
details.infringement: Breach of Article B1.6.3e of the FIA F1 Regulations.
details.decision: Driver: Reprimand (Driving). This is the driver’s 1st reprimand of the season.
details.reason: The Stewards reviewed in-car video evidence. The pit exit light turned red when the driver was approaching the pit exit to join the track for the re-start of the race after a suspension. Such an infringement happening during the race normally requires a very significant penalty as the drivers are obliged to obey light signals at all times. However, in this case the infringement did not happen during a live race, but rather on the build-up before the re-start, although the race had technically already resumed in accordance with Article B5.15.2g. In addition to that, the Stewards acknowledge that neither any advantage was gained nor any potentially dangerous or unsafe situation was created. Therefore a reprimand to the driver is deemed appropriate given the mitigating circumstances and the unique scenario.

documents.title: Doc 68 - Infringement - Car 55 - Collision with Car 23
documents.subject: Infringement - Car 55 - Collision with Car 23

details.fact: Causing a collision with Car 23 in Turn 1.
details.infringement: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
details.decision: 10 second time penalty.
details.reason: The Stewards reviewed video and in-car video evidence. The driver of Car 55 defended an overtaking attempt by Car 23 on the inside into Turn 1, but locked up and caused a collision between both cars. The Stewards determine that the driver of Car 55 was wholly at fault and issue the standard penalty for such incidents.

documents.title: Doc 63 - Infringement - Car 43 - Overtaking under yellow flags
documents.subject: Infringement - Car 43 - Overtaking under yellow flags

details.fact: Car 43 overtook Car 22 in a double yellow flag sector
details.infringement: Breach of Article B1.8.4b of the FIA F1 Regulations.
details.decision: Drive through penalty. 2 penalty points (total of 3 for the 12 month period).
details.reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, timing and in-car video evidence. Car 43 was behind Car 22 entering Turn 14 and overtook Car 22 in the double yellow flag sector before the Line at the end of Lap 1. Normally such infringement requires a 10 second stop/go penalty, but the Stewards acknowledge the complications caused by the significant amount of debris on track at this point and take this into account as mitigating circumstances.

documents.title: Doc 52 - Decision - Car 10 - alleged unsafe release
documents.subject: Decision - Car 10 - alleged unsafe release

details.fact: Alleged unsafe release of Car 10
details.infringement: Alleged breach of Article B1.6.2a of the FIA F1 Regulations.
details.decision: No further action.
details.reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 5 (Gabriel Bortoleto), the driver of Car 10 (Pierre Gasly) and their team representatives and reviewed video, timing, telemetry and in-car video evidence. Car 10 was released from its garage directly in front of Car 5 which had just left its garage, thereby requiring the driver of Car 5 to slightly brake in the fast lane. During the hearing both drivers agreed that the situation was not unsafe in any way, but rather very typical for cars heading out during qualifying. The Stewards agree that, although the driver of Car 5 had to react to Car 10 entering the fast lane in front of him, the car was not released in a way that could endanger pit lane personnel or another driver or that could cause damage to another car. Therefore no further action is taken.

documents.title: Doc 42 - Infringement - Car 5 - Unsafe release
documents.subject: Infringement - Car 5 - Unsafe release

details.fact: Car 5 was released into the path of Car 87 on the way to the reconnaissance laps.
details.infringement: Breach of Article B1.6.2a of the FIA F1 Regulations.
details.decision: Competitor: Warning.
details.reason: The Stewards reviewed video and in-car video evidence. Car 5 was released from its garage shortly after Car 87 and blocked Car 87 from proceeding to the end of the pit lane in the fast lane. This constitutes an unsafe release, although not dangerous in nature. Due to the proximity of both garages and the very limited time between both releases, the reaction time for the team to prevent the unsafe release was extremely short. Taking all this into account in mitigation, the Stewards determine that a Warning to the team is appropriate.

documents.title: Doc 41 - Infringement - Car 18 - Failure to follow Race Director's Instructions (Reaching the Grid)
documents.subject: Infringement - Car 18 - Failure to follow Race Director's Instructions (Reaching the Grid)

details.fact: The driver of Car 18 stopped his car before Safety Car Line 1 when driving to the grid.
details.infringement: Breach of Article 12.2.1.i of the International Sporting Code – Non-compliance with Race Director’s Event Note (item 24, document 5).
details.decision: No penalty is applied.
details.reason: The Stewards reviewed video and in-car video evidence. Car 18 stopped before reaching Safety Car Line 1 and therefore did not reach the grid (as defined in item 24 of the Race Director’s Competition Notes) under its own power. However, as the end of the grid was extremely crowded when the car reached the grid, the Stewards determine the the driver acted appropriately and stopped the car in a safe spot as close as possible to the grid. Therefore no penalty is applied.

documents.title: Doc 33 - Infringement - Car 55 - Starting procedure infringement
documents.subject: Infringement - Car 55 - Starting procedure infringement

details.fact: Car 55 overtook Car 77 during the formation lap.
details.infringement: Breach of Article B5.6.4 of the FIA F1 Regulations
details.decision: Driver: Warning.
details.reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence. Car 55 was mandated to start the Sprint from the pit lane because of another breach and therefore the driver entered the pit lane at the end of the formation lap. By doing so, he overtook Car 77 shortly before reaching Safety Car Line 1 and this is considered a breach of Article B5.6.4 of the FIA F1 Regulations. As the mandated consequence for such an infringement (pit lane start) is redundant in this case, the Stewards issue a Warning to the driver in line with previous decisions.

documents.title: Doc 22 - Infringement- Car 55 - driving unnecessarily slowly during sprint qualifying
documents.subject: Infringement- Car 55 - driving unnecessarily slowly during sprint qualifying

details.fact: Car 55 driving unnecessarily slowly during Sprint Qualifying
details.infringement: Breach of Article 12.2.1.i of the International Sporting Code and non-compliance with Race Director’s Competition Notes (item 1, document 5).
details.decision: Driver: Warning.
details.reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 55 (Carlos Sainz), team representative and reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, timing, telemetry, team radio and in-car video evidence. Car 55 had to let Car 16 by before Turn 13, this impacting his lap time delta. After that, the driver accelerated to make up time before coming into the pits, but still reached Safety Car Line 1 being approx. 5 seconds above the required maximum time. The driver explained that he could not accelerate the car in the way he wanted due to the fact that the battery of the car was empty, but also admitted that he could have done more to make up time before entering the pit lane. The Stewards acknowledge the difficulties arising from energy management, but also agree with the driver that he could have done more to manage his delta time and therefore determine that a Warning to the driver is appropriate.

documents.title: Doc 20 - Decision - Sprint Qualifying SC2-SC1 Times
documents.subject: Decision - Sprint Qualifying SC2-SC1 Times

details.fact: The F1 cars below exceeded the 1:28.00 time limit between the Safety Car lines.
details.infringement: Alleged breach of Article B1.8.5 of the FIA F1 Regulations and Article 12.2.1.i of the FIA International Sporting Code (non-compliance with the Race Director’s Competition Notes, item 1, document 5).
details.decision: No further action.
details.reason: The Stewards thoroughly reviewed Marshalling/Positioning data, timing data, on-board cameras and CCTV cameras. All drivers concerned stayed at or above speeds necessary to stay below 1:28.0 around the vast majority of the circuit. However, in all cases the Stewards determined that the drivers took appropriate actions to not impede other drivers, and in all cases, they slowed down significantly to allow other drivers to pass while giving those drivers a clear track. The Stewards therefore determine that all drivers concerned did not drive “unnecessarily slowly”, and that they were above the maximum time because they took appropriate steps, and we therefore take no further action.
